state_definitions.READY: Can start after checking concurrent work and current main.
state_definitions.BLOCKED_DATA: Requires measurements or authoritative parameter evidence.
state_definitions.PLANNED: Depends on prior accepted model stages.
state_definitions.COMPLETE: All acceptance evidence, provenance and limitations are recorded.
state_definitions.REJECTED: Tested and rejected; evidence must remain available.
